ADC_recommendation.contact_count_and_order_status: 2P signal-plus-GND recommendation accepted by user; physical pin order and mating-view drawing pending.
ADC_recommendation.locking_evidence: Domestic product listing for the matching 2PJK housing explicitly specifies a locking feature; the 2PWB listing identifies the same housing and DZ contact as its mating set.
ADC_recommendation.wire: Suggested AWG28 signal/GND pair; DZ product data specifies AWG28 through AWG32. Prefer correctly crimped/preassembled matching harnesses.
ADC_recommendation.layout: Two groups of five ADC connectors along two board edges, side-entry wiring. Check mated housing, latch access, cable bend space and standoffs in the new 60x60mm PCB layout.
ADC_recommendation.signal_notes: Keep signal and its GND together; twisted pairs are a proposed harness option. NTC and voltage/current sensing remain conditioned low-voltage outputs from the power board.

PWM_recommendation.mating_housing_procurement_status: Model identified in domestic header listing; exact housing procurement entry still to be recorded before BOM selection.

source_notes: Domestic LCSC indexed/detail content checked for model, part code, dimensions and mating set. Some repeat direct requests return anti-bot challenges; no live stock or price claim. Manufacturer series page: https://www.xunpu.com.cn/product/440.html .
